defs.def: an activity that you do for pleasure when you are not working 业余爱好

ex.s: While they were told the study was about cognitive processes, participants were asked about interests, with around half saying they had an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 虽然参与者被告知这项研究是关于认知过程的，但他们也被问及兴趣爱好，约一半人说自己有艺术爱好。

ex.s: Among those, the effect was greater: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.
ex.t: 在其中，效果更明显：有艺术爱好的“美”组在抽象思维上的平均得分比有艺术爱好的对照组高出25%以上。

ex.s: Beauty group, with an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 美感组中有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Beauty group, without an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 美感组中没有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Control group, with an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 对照组中有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Control group, without an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 对照组中没有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: I’ve discovered that if I show students how what they learn is relevant to my hobbies, they’re much more willing to make connections to their personal interests and develop their own hobbies.
ex.t: 我发现，如果我向学生展示所学内容与我的爱好的关联，他们就更愿意把知识与自己的兴趣联系起来，并培养出自己的爱好。

ex.s: No matter what subject I’m teaching, I find ways to bring my hobbies into the classroom.
ex.t: 无论教什么科目，我都会想办法把我的爱好带进课堂。

ex.s: When I first brought my hobbies to my classroom, I was focused on how doing so would build engagement and help my students understand concepts in science.
ex.t: 最初把爱好带进课堂时，我关注的是这样做能如何提高参与度、帮助学生理解科学概念。

ex.s: Even when I’m planning classes, I tend to think about how I can bring in my hobbies.
ex.t: 即使在我备课的时候，我也倾向于想着怎么把我的爱好带进去。

ex.s: Best of all, my passion for my hobbies seems to inspire them to be passionate about finding their own.
ex.t: 最棒的是，我对爱好的热情似乎激励他们也热情地去寻找自己的爱好。

ex.s: The gap between teachers’ and students’ hobbies.
ex.t: 老师与学生爱好之间的差距。

ex.s: Hoping to find a hobby that can be shared by both the little ones and adults? ___36___ You may know the “feel-good” emotions that come with helping others, but there are even more unexpected ways volunteering will positively affect the whole family.
ex.t: 想找一个大小孩和成人都能共享的爱好吗？___36___（这里有个建议）你可能知道帮助他人带来的“感觉良好”情绪，但志愿服务以更意想不到的方式积极影响整个家庭。

ex.s: For Ribeiro, it has become a perfect platform for ___45___ her hobby of buying food, ___46___ new recipes and holding dinner parties.
ex.t: 对Ribeiro来说，这已成为一个完美平台，让她得以___45___购买食材的爱好、___46___新食谱并举办晚宴。

ex.s: Though DIY has traditionally been seen as male hobby, the research shows it is women now leading the charge.
ex.t: 尽管DIY传统上被视为男性的爱好，但研究显示，如今是女性冲在最前面。

ex.s: To encourage her to take up a hobby.
ex.t: 为了鼓励她培养一个爱好。

ex.s: ________our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who enjoy the same hobbies, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: ________我们的爱好，互联网可以将我们与世界上其他地方享受相同爱好的人联系起来，即使他们住在地球的另一端。

ex.s: He gave up his hobby.
ex.t: 他放弃了他的爱好。

ex.s: Today his hobby has developed into the website postcrossing.com, a social network that has grown to 575,217 registered users in 214 countries and regions since he started it 10 years ago.
ex.t: 如今，他的爱好已发展成一个网站 postcrossing.com——一个社交网络，自他十年前创建以来，已发展到214个国家和地区的575,217名注册用户。

ex.s: He likes to think of sending postcards as a family-friendly hobby.
ex.t: 他喜欢把寄明信片看作一种适合全家的爱好。

ex.s: Many people have the hobby of collecting things, eg stamps, postcards or antiques.
ex.t: 许多人都有收集东西的爱好，例如邮票、明信片或古董。

ex.s: He's not ready to retire, but he's found a new hobby to keep his hands skillful in the years to come.
ex.t: 他还没准备退休，但已找到一项新爱好，让他的双手在未来岁月里保持灵巧。

ex.s: Zachariah Fike has an unusual hobby.
ex.t: 扎卡赖亚·法伊克有个不同寻常的爱好。

ex.s: To help him start a hobby
ex.t: 为了帮他培养爱好

ex.s: Whatever our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who also enjoy doing them, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: 无论我们的爱好是什么，互联网都能让我们与那些也喜欢这些爱好的人建立联系，即使他们生活在世界的另一端。

ex.s: No matter what our hobbies are, with the help of the Internet, we can find other people who enjoy doing the same thing.
ex.t: 无论我们的爱好是什么，在互联网的帮助下，我们可以找到其他喜欢同样事情的人。

ex.s: At first, I only regarded it as a hobby, but companies started paying me to take photos and publish them.
ex.t: 起初，我只把它看作是一种爱好，但公司开始付钱给我拍照和发布它们。

ex.s: Or perhaps, that need to know that they should look for a different hobby.
ex.t: 或者，也许他们需要知道他们应该寻找一个不同的爱好。

ex.s: I’m now trying to spend less time online and more time picking up my hobbies.
ex.t: 我现在正努力花更少的时间在网上，花更多的时间重拾我的爱好。
